description: EG x VCA: an envelope generator and a stereo VCA in one module, with a pan control

params.text: Sets the gain applied to the signal by the VCA.
Pans the output, and works for a mono input as well as a stereo one.
Reshapes the envelope curves a little, to tame or exaggerate clicks.
Sets how long the envelope takes to climb to full.
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall from full to the sustain level, or the hold time in DAHD mode.
Sets the level the envelope holds at while the gate stays high, or the decay time in DAHD mode.
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall to zero once the gate falls.
Switches the envelope between digital and analogue curve behaviour.
Sets the shape of the attack stage: faster, standard or slower.
Sets the shape of the decay stage: faster, standard or slower.
Sets the shape of the release stage: faster, standard or slower.
Switches the envelope between ADSR, which suits sustained sounds, and DAHD, which suits drums.
Modulation depth for one of the four modulation inputs into the knob it belongs to; the figure is the shift a plus or minus 10V signal produces.
Switches the envelope between the fast and the slow time range.

inputs.text: The left channel into the VCA.
The right channel into the VCA.
A gate opens the envelope and holds it at the sustain level; its length sets the polyphony.
Sets the tempo for the tempo-synced controls, taking a quarter-note trigger or, when the menu is switched to BPM CV, a tempo voltage.
Carries a modulation signal; arm it with its button, then turn a knob to set how far this signal moves that knob.

outputs.text: The left channel out of the VCA.
The right channel out of the VCA.
Carries the envelope on its own.
A trigger when the envelope finishes; the menu can widen this to fire at every stage change.

menu: Clock in QuarterNotes — reads the clock input as a quarter-note trigger, and the panel labels that jack CLOCK.
Clock in BPM CV — reads the clock input as a tempo voltage, and the panel labels that jack BPM.
Attack from Zero — starts a retriggered attack at zero even when the envelope has not finished.
Attack from Current (Legato) — starts a retriggered attack from the level the envelope had reached.
Stereo Pan: Balance — pans by turning one side down, so the far side falls silent.
Stereo Pan: True Panning — pans by moving one side across into the other.
EOC Trigger Point — a submenu choosing what fires the end-of-cycle trigger, from End of Cycle and Start of Cycle through the start of each individual stage to Trigger on All Transitions.
Use Global Style — ties this module's appearance to the setting shared by every Surge XT module, rather than to this module alone.
Skin — sets the panel colouring: Dark, Medium or Light.
Colors — a submenu setting the colour of the Display Area, Knob and Slider Values, Modulations and Power Buttons, and carrying Show Knob Shadows.
Value Displays — a submenu carrying Knob Value Rings, Knob Modulation Animations and Display Modulation Animations.
